stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 1 & 17 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Carl Ryder with 39 pts - minor premiership sewn up, now for the hard part

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 13 on the back nine after 7 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 216 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Great Escape
stories.detail: Michael McCormack finished 21 pts - the great escape, and he knows how close it was

stories.title: Group Honours
stories.detail: Mike Whelan pipped Geoff King in their own group - 38 to 37, a one-shot family feud

stories.title: Relatively Good Golf
stories.detail: Gabrielle and Angus Bolton both up the board - must be something in the water at home

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Great to have you with us, Stephen Martin from Duntryleague GC. Enjoy your round and the 19th afterwards.

stories.title: Playing Off the Wrong Card
stories.detail: Off 40 and lighting it up - 6th on the board

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (1) and 7th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Turn for the Better
stories.detail: Caught fire at the turn - 9 across 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 22, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 4 twos on holes 14-17 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Clean but Not Pretty
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers and not a single wipe - disciplined mediocrity

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 12-16

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - club still in the bag

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 14, 15 & 16

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 5 twos on holes 10-14 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 6 & 7 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: The Course Wins Again
stories.detail: 3 straight on holes 4, 5 & 6 - the handicap card stays in the bag

comingLast.roast: done on 20 - somebody propose a toast so he cannot slip out mid-cheer
at 1.3 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
needs 1 point from his last 4 to hand the blue balls to Smyth
in the clubhouse 1 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
only 1 clear of the blue balls - one blow-up and they are his
safety margin 1 - his playing partners call it 'the plank'
1 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
in the clubhouse 6 above Smyth - cheering for him from a safe distance
